name: bums.level.w2-09.name
authorNotes: Solo. The set piece: the kitchen floods with ketchup from below. The flood hazard (0,2200 rising to 0,400 at 40px/s, per design) is a crusher whose path climbs the full height of the level — it starts below the starting counter, so it is not an immediate threat, and grab camera-9 (330,1740) at spawn before it becomes one. A thin static void strip (0,2250) sits beneath the very start, punishing anyone knocked off before the flood even arrives, same trick as the World 1 Showdown tide. The escape is three flood-lift platforms (flood-lift-1/2/3), each drifting once (loop: false) along a short rising path and holding at the end, climbed back-to-back for a continuous ascent whose static angle steps up each time (0, 0.15, 0.3 rad) so the structure reads as increasingly tilted the higher you climb — the same translate-and-step approximation w1-09's crane used for the same reason: Prop.angle has no time-animated rotation field in the current contract, so a truly rotating rigid body is out of this ticket's scope (types.ts is not mine to edit). The checkpoint sits at flood-lift-2's landing (1300,1150) so a fall partway up the climb doesn't send you back to the floor. swing-flood-final (pivot 1750,700, 220px) closes the last gap into the goal counter (1820-2400) with the flood by now a receding memory below. camera-9 makes the photo objective (allAirborne) easiest between lift segments. Two short assist beams bridge the first mount and the last gap for a party that would rather not trust the ketchup's patience.
